news.title: The 78-year-old manager who once led the Korean team, after guiding them to their first World Cup appearance, resigned, returned, and re-signed... Advocaet continues writing Curaçao's history
news.lede: Dick Advocaat (78), who previously coached the South Korean national football team, continues his career as a head coach. Reuters reported on the 10th (Korea time) that "the Curaçao Football Association has extended its contract with manager Dick Advocaat." As a result, Advocaat will continue to lead the Curaçao national team until July next year. The partnership between Curaçao and manager Advocaat has not been without significant ups and downs.

news.title: PSG Vs Slovan: World Cup Hero Ferran Torres Hits Hat-Trick In 6-1 Thrashing Of Bratislava
news.lede: Paris Saint-Germain made a flying start to their bid for a third straight Champions League crown, sweeping aside Slovan Bratislava 6-1 at the Parc des Princes on Wednesday as Ousmane Dembele and Ferran Torres stole the spotlight. Dembele, the reigning Ballon d’Or winner, struck twice before the half-hour mark before turning provider for Torres, whose finish made it 3-0 before the break. The former Barcelona forward completed his hat-trick shortly after half-time, scoring twice more to put the result beyond doubt. Suleiman Camara pulled a goal back for the Slovakian champions, but Fabian Ruiz restored PSG’s five-goal advantage late on.

news.title: 'We're up 70% from the World Cup in 23' but growth in registered female footballers has slowed
news.lede: Growth in registered female football players has plateaued after an initial explosion in participation following the World Cup breakthrough. Pic: David Fitzgerald/Sportsfile. Lizzy Kent was installed as head of women’s and girls’ football at the FAI in January and will produce her own action plan once the underwhelming two-year version unfurled by her predecessor Hannah Dingley expires in March. Compared to a figure of 45,000 players referenced in that blueprint of 2025, the latest figure is put at 47,000, a mere 5% increase over an 18-month period.

news.title: ‘Not today, not here’: Infantino tight-lipped on abandoned World Cup rights proposal
news.lede: FIFA President Gianni Infantino, who attended the opening match of the Under-20 Women's World Cup in Katowice on Saturday, remained tight-lipped about whether he regrets his abandoned proposal to sell a stake in the World Cup. The event is the first tournament organised by world soccer's ruling body since the Swiss administrator called off the plan, which valued the commercial rights of the World Cup and other FIFA tournaments at $20 billion. The proposal was abandoned in late July following a fierce backlash and boycott threats from regional governing bodies, including Europe's UEFA and major stakeholders in the sport. news.title: AFA hopes Benin and Burkina Faso can tempt Messi to one last dance in Argentina
news.lede: Lionel Messi may have announced his retirement from international football, but the Argentine Football Association (AFA) is not quite ready to let him go. AFA is preparing to invite Messi to return as skipper once again for Argentina’s next round of home friendlies, potentially giving the 39-year-old a fond farewell in front of his own supporters. Authorities are lining up two games, at the Monumental in Buenos Aires and the Mario Alberto Kempes stadium in Córdoba, and they want Messi to remain the star attraction. The proposed matches would form part of the next FIFA international window, running from September 21 to October 6.
